Class SecurityAction

java.lang.Object
grafiosch.entities.BaseID<Integer>
grafioschtrader.entities.SecurityAction
@Entity public class SecurityAction extends BaseID<Integer>
System-wide corporate action recorded by an administrator. The instrument references identify the predecessor and successor of an ISIN change or the parent and child of a spin-off.
